review_method: Run each prompt with the new skill. Compare actual artifacts to criteria, not exact wording. Do not call Google for cover-only cases. Use dry-run document delivery for behavioral tests.

cases.prompt: We need a Framer developer to rebuild our SaaS pricing page. Keep our existing components, improve mobile layout, and start your reply with PRICING. Under 90 words please.
checks: Cover only; begins PRICING; under 90 words
Discusses existing components and mobile layout
No AI pitch or invented conversion improvement

cases.prompt: Cover letter only: connect our website form to HubSpot, send Gmail acknowledgement, and alert Slack using n8n. Avoid duplicate follow-up tasks. Screening question: how would you handle retries?
checks: No Google call
Deterministic sync and duplicate handling
Retry answer separate from letter
No fabricated 80% metric or free audit

cases.prompt: Proposal only: build a support assistant that drafts answers from our approved knowledge base. Agents must approve every reply. Need test coverage for missing source information.
checks: Detailed Doc draft only
Human approval retained; no automatic send
Grounding and missing-answer acceptance cases
Conditional timeline; no invented price

cases.prompt: Both: build a Next.js customer portal and a background CRM sync. Existing login must remain. Quote $2,400 total, with delivery estimated at three weeks after API access.
checks: Cover and Doc agree on scope
Supplied price and schedule preserved with dependency
Existing login addressed
No extra commitments

cases.prompt: Proposal for my Upwork job please.
checks: Ask for job description; no fabricated project or Google Doc

cases.prompt: Cover letter for a Salesforce migration. Client asks for two Salesforce migrations you personally completed. No Salesforce case studies are supplied.
checks: Ask for required experience evidence or clearly disclose gap
No invented projects or substituted irrelevant website URLs

cases.prompt: Proposal: one-page Webflow site with supplied copy. Job budget $800. No quote from me yet.
checks: Budget not presented as agreed quote
Simple proposal allowed under two pages
No padded agency introduction

cases.prompt: We generated both earlier. Revise only the cover letter to 70 words, keeping the approach.
checks: Only letter revised; no Doc mutation
70-word request honored
